title: Amazingly Aromatic Dutch Chicken Stew
description: A spicy and creamy Dutch chicken stew made with plain flour and double-fry KFC method, served in a dolsot stone bowl, this dish is a comforting and aromatic meal, kosher-friendly and perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Double-fry the chicken by first frying at 350 degrees for 5 minutes, then increasing the heat to 400 degrees for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the oil and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the paprika and cayenne pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and add the heavy cream to the skillet.
Add the fried chicken back to the skillet and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew in a dolsot stone bowl.
